subject: More than £2m spent by government on influencers since July 2024
posts:
Taxpayers fund the spin! Government departments have poured over £2.4m into social media influencers since July 2024.
Evidence: public outreach claims, partisan messaging spin, £2.4m spent
#Aletheia #UKPolitics

Ministers argue that collaborating with online creators helps reach younger demographics and harder-to-engage communities with vital public health and tax guidance.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.2) — Good Preference

Behind the public service veneer, departments use public funds to buy influencer endorsements and shape political narratives, insulating incumbents from scrutiny.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.65, -0.75) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Public funds are diverted into curated social media praise, masking institutional policy failures behind celebrity endorsements.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.2, z: 1)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Department for Education: COND (-0.6, -0.7) — £700k+ spent on childcare & teacher recruitment.
- HMRC & DWP Spin: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Buying trusted voices to manage public compliance.
Government departments across successive administrations have increasingly bypassed traditional press channels, paying social media creators to promote key policy initiatives directly to citizens.

The Bright Side:
Targeted digital campaigns can genuinely improve public awareness around tax deadlines, childcare support, and career progression pathways.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHO benefits (citizens vs. political incumbents). The stated goal is public information, but the actual beneficiary is the governing party's PR strategy.

Social Physics Analysis:
Officials run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing partisan reputation management as civic education. Instead of solving systemic policy breakdowns through transparent public accountability, they deploy paid influencer proxies to project competence and manufacture positive public sentiment.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. By monetizing digital trust, the state degrades organic public discourse into a pay-to-play promotional asset.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public communications require modern channels to reach diverse citizen demographics effectively.

The Unavoidable Lie: Taxpayer-funded influencer collaborations are purely neutral civic education devoid of political spin.

Alethekanon:
When public funds buy influencer praise, civic communication collapses into state-sponsored marketing. True democratic engagement requires open accountability, not monetized endorsement.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts to see genuine efforts to help parents and young people get tangled up in political point-scoring and distrust. People just want honest, straightforward help without wondering who got paid to say it.

Brothekanon:
Imagine paying reality stars to tell people how great the government is doing. Classic state-backed PR stunt, and everyone can see right through the glossy TikTok aesthetic.

Spirithekanon:
"Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt" Colossians 4:6 PASS
True public leadership relies on authentic truth and integrity, not monetized flattery bought with taxpayer coin.
